parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The main streaming domain to query.

*   You can query one or more domain names. If you specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).
*   If you leave this parameter empty, the data of all domain names within your Alibaba Cloud account is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

>  You can query data in the last **90** days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-snapshot-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 2018-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2018-01-02T00:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
